prerequisites: Students must possess the basic knowledge and skills required by their study program and necessary for carrying out the activities agreed upon in the training project.

learning_outcomes.text: Enable the student to use the knowledge acquired during the course of study and complete it in activities carried out at a company or industrial structure or at a research laboratory.
Acquire direct knowledge of the professional, organizational, technical, or research context in which the activity took place.
Be able to apply the knowledge acquired during the course of study to concrete problems, contributing to the performance of activities consistent with the educational objectives of the Study Program.
Understand the functioning of the host entity, laboratory, company, or structure.
Apply tools, methods, and procedures relevant to the internship area.
Collaborate with the tutor and any work groups.
Clearly document the activities carried out and the results achieved.
Develop operational autonomy, organizational skills, and awareness of their professional role.
Critically reflect on the experience, connecting it to their educational path.

syllabus_topics: The internship consists of carrying out practical, design, technical, organizational, experimental or research activities at an internal or external structure of the University, under the supervision of a university tutor and, where provided, a tutor from the host entity.

assessment_methods.method: Verification of regular performance of activities

assessment_rules: The internship includes an eligibility assessment with registration but no traditional examination. Eligibility is awarded based on verification of the regular performance of the activities planned in the training project, completion of the expected number of hours/credits, the tutor's evaluation, and the submission of final documentation. The final outcome is expressed as eligible/not eligible.
degree: Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica e Automatica (L-8)
